drhp.business: Seya Industries Ltd was engaged in the manufacture of specialty chemicals with applications in end-user segments including computer printing inks, pigments and paints, pharmaceuticals, personal and healthcare products, agrochemicals, insecticides/pesticides, organic chemical intermediates, rubber chemicals, textile dyes and thermic fluids. The Company is principally engaged in the business of Speciality Chemical Intermediates and has identified a single operating segment in accordance with Ind AS 108. The Company continued to remain under CIRP during FY2025-26, with manufacturing operations suspended throughout the period and no revenue from operations.

litigation.note: The Company is undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, initiated by NCLT Mumbai Bench order dated 2nd November 2023 in CP (IB) 446 MB 2023; Mr. Bhavesh Rathod was appointed Interim Resolution Professional and the powers of the Board of Directors stand suspended, as disclosed in the MD&A.
